scope: LOCAL FORK ONLY: nothing is sent to the public chain

checks.name: test accounts funded with the quote asset (raw units)
factory approves the stock as a quote asset
paired launch with the stock as first buy; curve holds exactly its liabilities
zero creator purchase gives no launched-token allocation
buy with the stock; balance delta equals the amount spent
sell back into the stock; payout is exact and the curve stays fully backed
protocol and creator fees paid in the stock, raw amounts exact
curve completes on a stock-denominated purchase
final stock purchase graduates in the same transaction
migration preserves raw quote accounting including quote dust
graduation into Uniswap v3 with the stock as the quote side; price continuous; position locked
post-graduation buy and sell through Uniswap v3 with the stock
locked position collects fees in the stock; principal unchanged
post-graduation creator and treasury claims pay exact 50/50 shares; LP principal stays locked

limits: All transactions and deployments were local to the fork. No public transactions were sent.
One canonical Ethereum asset at one block; no BNB or Solana compatibility assertion.
Local Uniswap v3 deployment and mock native USD feed; no production stock oracle or public-pool liquidity validation.
Issuer admin powers, corporate actions and end-user eligibility remain unverified. Live capabilities remain disabled.
